The latest decision on each artifact named: its features and its disposition, as a list, or as JSON Lines with -o json. Exits 1 when none is recorded

Usage: byrle artifact show [OPTIONS] <--digest <DIGEST>|--purl <PURL>|--npm <NAME@VERSION>>

Options:
      --digest <DIGEST>     One artifact's digest, for example sha512-...
      --purl <PURL>         One package version, for example pkg:npm/ms@2.1.3. A PyPI version has one artifact per file
      --npm <NAME@VERSION>  One npm package version as npm's errors print it, for example @babel/core@7.0.0
  -o, --output <OUTPUT>     How each decision is printed: a list to read, or the JSON line the store keeps [default: text] [possible values: text, json]
  -h, --help                Print help
